conventions.text: No text is baked; the game renders all text.
conventions.pads: ui_pad_* are 192x96 iso (2:1) diamonds like assets/ui pads: tip-to-tip ~170 px, anchor = centre, footprint [170, 85]. White engraved symbol, colour-coded fill.
conventions.iso: World axes run at +-26.565 deg on screen (A = down-right (2,1), B = up-right (2,-1)); 1 m along an axis = 50.6 px, 1 m across = 40.5 px perpendicular.
conventions.blend: All FX sheets are NORMAL-blend artwork (ADD vanishes on snow).
conventions.sheets: Frames left->right, wrapped into rows so no sheet is wider than 2048 px. Phaser anim key = sheet key.
conventions.fogLayers: Back->front: fog_bank (wall, opaque top, scroll ~6 px/s), fog_bank_mid (draw ~56 px lower, ~13 px/s), fog_bank_front (draw ~216 px lower than the wall top, ~30 px/s). All tile in x (TileSprite.tilePositionX). Fill everything beyond the wall with fog_bank.fillColor. When a watchtower clears an area: tween the layers' alpha to 0 (~0.8 s) and burst 10-20 fog_puff particles outward.

spritesheets.notes: Construction hammer puff: pow star + warm dust balls rolling out on the ground + wood chips. Anchor = ground point. Play on every hammer hit (~0.5 s).
Building complete: flash, golden iso ground ring, light fan, fountain of stars + confetti. Anchor = footprint centre; scale x1.3-1.6 for 3x3 m buildings.

Boat wake loop on dark sea: 3 foam rings spreading from the hull + waterline collar + bubbles. Anchor = hull centre at the waterline; draw UNDER the boat. Clear centre ~92x40 px. Scale x0.7 for the rowboat, x1.2 for the fishing boat.
Extra: one expanding foam ring. Spawn at the stern of a MOVING boat every ~0.25 s (world space, under the boat) - the rings form a V-shaped wake trail by themselves.
Watchtower fire basket loop (tall flames + embers; add fx_smoke_puff above for smoke). Anchor = base of the flames (basket rim, buildings fxPoints.fire).

ui_icon_zoom_in.notes: Magnifier with a green plus (zoom in).

ui_icon_zoom_out.notes: Magnifier with a red minus (zoom out).

ui_icon_map.notes: Folded parchment map with a red pin (overview / "show all").

ui_icon_people.notes: Three villager heads in yellow/red/blue parka hoods (population).

ui_icon_clerk.notes: Shop clerk bust: red-white headscarf + striped apron.

ui_icon_porter.notes: Porter (orange beanie, green scarf) with a crate stack on a back frame.

ui_icon_tools.notes: Crossed axe + pickaxe (tools from the toolsmith).

ui_icon_food.notes: Bread loaf + smoked drumstick (miners' food / food supply).

ui_icon_lock_open.notes: Open gold padlock + twinkle (unlocked); pairs with ui/ui_icon_lock.

ui_pad_clerk.notes: Iso 2:1 floor pad (192x96), pink, cash register + "+": hire a clerk for this counter. Diamond tip-to-tip ~170 px.

ui_pad_porter.notes: Iso 2:1 floor pad (192x96), lime green, porter carrying crates on a back frame + "+": hire a porter for this line. Diamond tip-to-tip ~170 px.

ui_pad_build.notes: Iso 2:1 floor pad (192x96), coral red, hammer + "+": empty building site, opens the build menu. Diamond tip-to-tip ~170 px.

ui_pad_tower.notes: Iso 2:1 floor pad (192x96), violet, watchtower with a beacon fire: build the watchtower (expands the territory). Diamond tip-to-tip ~170 px.

ui_pad_boat.notes: Iso 2:1 floor pad (192x96), deep-sea indigo, sailing boat: buy / upgrade a boat at the pier. Diamond tip-to-tip ~170 px.

ui_pad_register.notes: Iso 2:1 floor pad (192x96), teal, two footprints + coin: the spot where the chief / clerk stands to take payment. Diamond tip-to-tip ~170 px.

ui_card.notes: Build-menu card (9-slice). Recommended 120-220 px wide, 120-260 px tall; content inset [l, t, r, b] keeps text off the rim and the bottom lip.

ui_card_selected.notes: Selected build-menu card: gold rim + glow + twinkle, same size/margins as ui_card. Recommended 120-220 px wide, 120-260 px tall; content inset [l, t, r, b] keeps text off the rim and the bottom lip.

ground_road.notes: Packed-snow cobble road, seamless 512 (cobbles are iso-foreshortened). Fill road cells with it at scale 1 (TileSprite / pattern), then lay road_edge along the borders.

road_edge.notes: Seamless in x (512x64). Centre line (y=32) on the road boundary, top half over the road, bottom half fades into the snow. Along a world axis rotate by +-26.57 deg (flipY for the opposite side); shading is mild so flips/rotations look right.

fog_bank.notes: Drifting snow-fog WALL (back layer, also fine alone): top 194 rows fully opaque #E6EEF6 (continue with a rect of fillColor beyond), soft cloud banks, puffy lip ending near y=209, faint cool ground shadow below. Anchor = top centre; place the wall so its lip sits just outside the territory border.

fog_bank_mid.notes: Mid fog band (transparent top) hanging in front of the wall lip; draw over fog_bank 56 px lower, scroll ~2x faster.

fog_bank_front.notes: Front layer: drifting blowing-snow wisps + flakes over the border; draw last (~216 px below the wall top), scroll fastest. Optional.

fog_puff.notes: Soft fog billow particle (light blue-white baked, feathered rim). Fog clearing: emit 10-20, scale 0.6->1.6, drift outward/up, alpha 1->0 over ~1 s.
